original_method: Preserve the TBD source and prohibit execution until a vendor/corrected contract defines the target object, exact setter/getter, encoding, range, effect, acceptance and restore procedure.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies and approves the exact thermal object, local setter/getter, units/range, baseline, requested value, expected protection effect, dedicated SUT, maintenance window, monitoring limits, fallback and full restore.

safety_requirements: No write while source remains TBD

Read back and observe bounded effect
engineer_actions: Approve semantics, exact value, safety envelope and recovery

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the placeholder into a reversible thermal-policy transaction with target-specific schema, approved safe value, independent monitoring, one write, exact readback and deterministic restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines the entire safety and recovery contract that a TBD setter lacks while keeping execution prohibited.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Thermal getters establish only read semantics, OOB uses a different route, and power-limit setters do not establish component temperature policy or units.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect target, scale or value can remove hardware protection, cause sustained throttling, induce shutdown or obscure a real thermal fault; recovery may require fallback access.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title identifies an in-band thermal-limit setter while Procedure and Criteria are placeholders. The source is incomplete, but it does not contain competing asserted operations.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended write is identifiable. The specification, target object, value, acceptance and recovery are concrete prerequisites; classify BLOCKED only if those remain indeterminate or contradictory after the authoritative artifact is supplied.

review_improvement: Defines a safe, reversible path for a TBD thermal-policy write without inventing the command or value.
independent_technical_reasoning: A thermal-limit setter directly influences protection behavior, yet the source provides no target component, unit, valid range or recovery path. That absence prohibits execution but does not erase the identifiable setter purpose. An authoritative artifact can resolve it only if it binds the write to a precise object and getter, while independent thermal/workload monitoring proves the requested value is safe and restoration returns the entire policy—not just one number—to baseline.
